title: KUTUMB X SCROLL
tagline: Revolutionize DAO with our multi-channel team communication, seamless file sharing, streamings and more, all in one platform on Scroll, so what you are waiting, subscribe us!
description:
The need for a secure, efficient, and cost-effective platform for social impact organizations to collaborate and work together inspired the creation of Kutumb X Scroll DAO. Kutumbh X Scroll DAO provides a secure, decentralised, and transparent solution by leveraging blockchain technology and the Scroll protocol, allowing social impact organisations to collaborate more effectively.
Kutumb offers a secure and decentralized platform for sharing files within a DAO. By allowing members to upload files, folders, or encrypted Content IDs (CIDs) to the platform, Kutumb makes it easy for teams to share information and collaborate on projects. This is particularly useful for social impact organizations and startups that need to store and share large files securely.

With its chat and multi-channel team communication features including push notifications, Kutumb also makes it easy for teams to stay connected and work together effectively. By providing a platform for team members to send and receive messages with it's inbuilt alert notifications, create specialized team channels.
how_its_made: Kutumbh X Scroll was built by me utilizing a range of technologies to create a robust and user-friendly platform. We used Solidity to build the ERC721 smart contracts that underpin the platform's subscription system, which was deployed on the Scroll Alphatestnet. For the front end, the developer used Next.js, a popular JavaScript framework for building web applications and for styling Tailwind CSS.
